sections.title: Active और Passive Voice की मूल अवधारणा
sections.content:
Active Voice में Subject कार्य करता है। Passive Voice में Subject पर कार्य होता है।
Step 1: Object को पहचानें।
Step 2: Object को Subject की जगह रखें।
Step 3: सही Tense के अनुसार 'be' verb + V3 लगाएँ।
Example: Ram writes a letter. → A letter is written by Ram.

sections.title: Simple Tenses (Present, Past, Future)
sections.content:
1. Present Simple: is/am/are + V3
Ram writes a letter. → A letter is written by Ram.
Step 1: writes = Present Simple पहचानें।
Step 2: is + written लगाएँ।

2. Past Simple: was/were + V3
Ram wrote a letter. → A letter was written by Ram.

3. Future Simple: will be + V3
Ram will write a letter. → A letter will be written by Ram.

sections.title: Continuous Tenses (Present, Past, Future)
sections.content:
1. Present Continuous: is/am/are being + V3
Ram is writing a letter. → A letter is being written by Ram.

2. Past Continuous: was/were being + V3
Ram was writing a letter. → A letter was being written by Ram.

3. Future Continuous: सामान्यतः Passive में प्रयोग नहीं होता।

sections.title: Perfect Tenses (Present, Past, Future)
sections.content:
1. Present Perfect: has/have been + V3
Ram has written a letter. → A letter has been written by Ram.

2. Past Perfect: had been + V3
Ram had written a letter. → A letter had been written by Ram.

3. Future Perfect: will have been + V3
Ram will have written a letter. → A letter will have been written by Ram.

sections.title: Modals के साथ Voice Change
sections.content:
Structure: Modal + be + V3

1. Can: Ram can solve the problem. → The problem can be solved by Ram.
2. Must: Ram must follow the rules. → The rules must be followed by Ram.
3. May: Ram may complete the work. → The work may be completed by Ram.

Step 1: Modal पहचानें।
Step 2: be जोड़ें।
Step 3: V3 का प्रयोग करें।

sections.title: दो Objects वाले वाक्य (Direct और Indirect)
sections.content:
Example: Ram gave me a book.
Step 1: दो objects पहचानें (me, a book)।
Step 2: किसी एक को Subject बनाएं।
1. I was given a book by Ram.
2. A book was given to me by Ram.
दोनों सही हैं।

sections.title: महत्वपूर्ण नियम
sections.content:
1. हमेशा V3 का प्रयोग करें।
2. Tense न बदलें।
3. Pronoun को Subject/Object के अनुसार बदलें (me → I, him → he)।
4. Future Continuous और Perfect Continuous सामान्यतः Passive में नहीं आते।

sections.title: सामान्य गलतियाँ
sections.content:
1. V2 या V1 लगा देना।
2. be verb भूल जाना।
3. Tense बदल देना।
4. Pronoun गलत रखना।

sections.title: त्वरित सारांश
sections.content: Object को Subject बनाएं + सही be verb + V3 लगाएं + by + doer। Modals में Modal + be + V3 याद रखें। Practice से Voice Change आसान हो जाता है।

tricks.title: Object पहले खोजें
tricks.explanation: Voice बदलने से पहले Object पहचानना जरूरी है।
tricks.example: She sings a song. → A song is sung by her.

tricks.title: V3 हमेशा लगाएँ
tricks.explanation: Passive Voice में हमेशा Verb की तीसरी form लगती है।

tricks.title: Simple Present पहचानें
tricks.explanation: यदि verb में s/es है तो is/am/are + V3 लगाएँ।
tricks.example: He plays cricket. → Cricket is played by him.

tricks.title: Past Simple ट्रिक
tricks.explanation: यदि verb V2 है तो was/were + V3 लगाएँ।
tricks.example: She cleaned the room. → The room was cleaned by her.

tricks.title: Future Simple ट्रिक
tricks.explanation: will के बाद be + V3 लगाएँ।
tricks.example: They will finish the work. → The work will be finished by them.

tricks.title: Continuous पहचानें
tricks.explanation: is/am/are/was/were + ing दिखे तो being + V3 लगाएँ।
tricks.example: He is making tea. → Tea is being made by him.

tricks.title: Perfect ट्रिक
tricks.explanation: has/have/had के बाद been + V3 लगाएँ।
tricks.example: She has completed work. → Work has been completed by her.

tricks.title: Modal Formula
tricks.explanation: Modal + be + V3 हमेशा याद रखें।
tricks.example: You must obey rules. → Rules must be obeyed by you.

tricks.title: Two Object Shortcut
tricks.explanation: जिस object को आसान लगे उसे Subject बना दें।
tricks.example: He gave me money. → I was given money by him.

tricks.title: Pronoun बदलना न भूलें
tricks.explanation: Object pronoun को Subject pronoun में बदलें।
